summary.change: If a promised accessory is missing, the buyer gets a full refund with return instead of a partial refund.

rows.title: PS Vita Slim
reasons_after: The item is missing a promised accessory (8GB SD card), which is classified as an incomplete item gap.
Under the tested policy change PROPOSED-1, if a promised accessory is missing, the buyer receives a full refund with return.
The seller admitted uncertainty about whether it was included, while the buyer provided photographic proof of the empty slot.

rows.title: Mint iPhone 6 AT&T 64GB
reasons_after: The item received has a 16GB storage capacity instead of the 64GB promised in the listing.
A different storage capacity constitutes a different model or version variation, making the item significantly not as described.
The buyer requested a return and refund rather than keeping the incorrect item.

rows.title: Zte Zmax Pro
reasons_after: The phone suffers from an undisclosed functional defect causing it to constantly turn off and restart.
Undisclosed defects affecting the function of the item qualify as significantly not as described under Buyer Protection.
A full refund with return is the appropriate outcome for a major functional failure.

rows.title: Fitbit Alta
reasons_after: The item is incomplete because promised accessories (black band and wireless dongle) were missing from the package.
The seller admitted to leaving the items in their drawer.
Under PROPOSED-1, missing promised accessories now direct a full refund with return.

rows.title: Stunning Vintage Dragon Ring
reasons_after: The listing explicitly stated no missing stones, but the item arrived with one eye stone missing.
A missing part/undisclosed defect on an item described as like new represents a significant gap under Buyer Protection.
The buyer provided clear macro photographic evidence supporting the complaint.

rows.title: Lululemon Size 2 Wunder Under Crop
reasons_after: The item received is a different size than advertised, which constitutes a significantly not as described issue.
The seller admitted to sending the wrong size.
The buyer provided photo evidence of the size tag showing size 6 instead of the ordered size 2.

rows.title: Paper Mario Sticker Star game for N 3DS
reasons_after: The buyer stated that the game and case are fine and admitted they just did not find it as fun as expected.
Buyer remorse and changes of mind are explicitly excluded from Buyer Protection coverage.
There are no defects, missing parts, or discrepancies compared to the listing description.

rows.title: New! Mainstays 8 Piece Bedding Set!
reasons_after: The listing clearly stated the item is queen size in both the title and description.
The buyer admits they actually need a king size and ordered the wrong size.
Placing the wrong order or changing one's mind is not covered under the Buyer Protection policy.

rows.title: Xbox one elite controller
reasons_after: The buyer received an incomplete item as standard accessories were missing.
Under proposed policy changes for missing accessories, the appropriate remedy is a full refund with return.

rows.title: J. Crew French Bulldog Sweater
reasons_after: The buyer reported pilling, but the seller clearly disclosed slight pilling in the listing description and photos.
Transactions with signs of wear that were correctly listed in used condition are not eligible for a refund under policy.
No undisclosed defects or significant discrepancies were found.

rows.title: Camo Speed Shorts Lululemon 6 Blue Lotus
reasons_after: The dispute is based on a subjective and non-significant colour variation.
The seller used the official Lululemon colour name in the listing.
Slight colour differences due to lighting or personal perception are not covered under Buyer Protection.

rows.title: Nike foamposite
reasons_after: The buyer's complaint concerns subjective condition opinions regarding the shoes' wear rating, which do not qualify as a significant gap.
The yellowing on the soles was explicitly disclosed by the seller in the listing description.
Items with signs of wear that match a correctly stated used condition are not eligible for a refund.

rows.title: iPhone 4 | SALE HURRY FAST
reasons_after: The item shows signs of wear that were correctly stated in the listing.
The flaws reported by the buyer (light scratches and a scratch/crack thing on the back) were fully disclosed by the seller.
Transactions with signs of wear matching a correctly stated used condition are not eligible for a refund.

rows.title: Vintage Nike Sportswear Crewneck
reasons_after: The listing explicitly stated no stains on a like-new item, making the undisclosed 2cm stain a significant gap.
The item is still completely usable and otherwise as described, making a partial refund appropriate.
Both the buyer and seller acknowledge the stain, with the seller offering a partial refund of $5.

rows.title: Halloween costume
reasons_after: The listing explicitly stated that thigh highs were included as part of the costume.
The buyer claims the thigh highs were missing from the package upon arrival, despite the seller providing pre-packing evidence.
Under the active policy change PROPOSED-1, missing promised accessories now trigger a full refund with return.
